VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
On November 21, 2019, Elon Musk launched the Cybertruck, and the market went crazy!!
In just under 2 day, they got 146,000 reservations, 250,000 reservations in five days and by October 2023 they had 1 Million reservations!!
and if these orders were fulfilled, Tesla would have made about $75 Billion dollars in revenue.
So on paper, the Cybertruck alone was worth more than Nike, Coca-Cola or Starbucks each bring in from an entire year of sales!!
